drugRefs.duration: 7-10 days (step down to oral when stable)
drugRefs.why: Ceftriaxone provides reliable coverage for S. pneumoniae and H. influenzae, the core typical pathogens, with good CNS and tissue penetration appropriate for severe disease.
Added for atypical and Legionella coverage, which is essential in severe CAP given the disproportionate contribution of Legionella to severe and fatal presentations.

drugRefs.coverage: Single-agent alternative covering typical and atypical organisms including Legionella; useful in macrolide or beta-lactam intolerance.

drugRefs.dose: 4.5 g IV q6h + Azithromycin as above
drugRefs.coverage: Used when structural lung disease or risk factors raise concern for Pseudomonas.

coverageMatrix.completeness: Combination covers ~90% of severe CAP pathogens; MRSA not covered unless risk factors present.
gaps: MRSA not covered — add vancomycin/linezolid only if post-influenza necrotizing pneumonia or risk factors are present.
Pseudomonas not covered unless structural lung disease present.

stewardship.deescalation: Narrow to pathogen-directed therapy once culture/antigen results return — e.g., positive pneumococcal urinary antigen with clinical improvement allows discontinuation of azithromycin and continuation of a beta-lactam alone.
